name: Profile Frame Generator
author: Jose Varghese

sections.description:
Profile Frame Generator helps organizers and campaigners easily create branded profile picture frames that supporters, attendees, volunteers, or speakers can overlay on their personal photos.

Whether you’re organizing a WordCamp, a local meetup, or running an awareness campaign, this plugin enables you to upload your own PNG frame and let users generate framed profile pictures directly from your WordPress site.

🎉 Key Features:

  • Upload a custom PNG frame from the admin settings.
  • Let users upload their photo, preview the frame, and download the final image.
  • Support for multiple frames using the shortcode.
  • Simple, fast, and self-hosted – no third-party services required.
  • Optimized for event organizers and campaign runners.

🖼 Multiple Frame Support:

To create multiple custom frames, use the shortcode:

[profile_frame frame="image_id_here"]

Replace image_id_here with the media ID of your PNG frame. Only one frame per page is supported. You can create separate pages for each frame, or a page with frame links that load the appropriate shortcode dynamically.

Example:
– Page A: [profile_frame frame="123"]
– Page B: [profile_frame frame="456"]

This allows you to manage multiple campaigns or audience groups with ease.

✅ Use Case Scenarios:

  • WordCamp or Meetup events
  • Local community gatherings
  • Social awareness campaigns
  • Celebrations like Pride, Earth Day, etc.

Note: WordCamp and WordPress are registered trademarks of the WordPress Foundation. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WordPress or WordCamp in any way. We use these terms only to illustrate potential use cases.

Support

For questions, support requests, or feature suggestions, please visit the support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/profile-frame-generator directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Profile Frame Generator to upload your PNG frame.
  4. Use the shortcode [profile_frame] or [profile_frame frame="image_id_here"] on a page where users can generate their profile picture.
sections.faq:
Can I use multiple frames?

Yes. Use the shortcode [profile_frame frame="image_id_here"] for each frame. Each page should contain only one frame.

What type of image should I use as the frame?

Upload a transparent PNG image with the intended design or border. The frame will be layered above the user’s uploaded image.

Can I change the frame dynamically via buttons or links?

Yes. You can create a landing page with buttons or links that redirect to pages containing the correct frame ID in the shortcode.
